text: {"question":"How did the conclusions about the ability of the considered models to resolve the Hubble tension change from the earlier to the later study?","reference_answer":"The earlier work noted that early‑time modifications were not yet explored and that late‑time effects remained relevant, implying limited progress on the Hubble tension.
